item.title: Patch: BeyondTrust Remote Support: Authentication Bypass by Spoofing
item.description:
BeyondTrust Remote Support: Authentication bypass · internet-facing · exploited · check vendor

First step: Follow the vendor advisory for BeyondTrust Remote Support: install the update or apply the mitigation it lists.

BeyondTrust Remote Support contains an authentication bypass by spoofing vulnerability that could allow a remote attacker to perform file operations on the appliance.

Critical · Check vendor · CVE-2026-102764
